info.title: Domibus REST Plugin API
info.description: The Domibus REST Plugin provides a simplified and secure external interface for integrating backend applications to exchange eDelivery AS4 messages using synchronous and asynchronous REST communication.

get.description:
Get a list of messages with filtering and pagination. Use `Prefer` header for performance optimization and `fields` parameter for granular field selection.

**Performance Optimization:**
- **Prefer: return=minimal** - Returns MessageSummary (id, message_id, msh_role, processing_type, status, sent_at). Minimal joins, fastest.
- **Prefer: return=representation** (default) - Returns MessageDetails with full metadata (message_properties, party_info, collaboration_info, attachments metadata).

**Field Selection:** Use `fields` to add/override included fields. Supports **field groups** ('metadata', 'attachments', 'errors') and **individual fields** ('message_properties', 'party_info'). Note: When Prefer=minimal, Java returns MessageSummary objects; with Prefer=representation, returns MessageDetails objects. Fields parameter controls which properties are populated within those objects.

parameters.name: msh_role
parameters.description: The MSH role to filter messages, SENDING or RECEIVING.

parameters.name: processing_type
parameters.description: The processing type, PUSH or PULL.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status to filter messages. Only READY_TO_PULL and SEND_ENQUEUED are allowed.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Filter by Domibus AS4 message ID (business identifier, e.g., 'msg-123@domibus.eu'). This is distinct from the REST API's internal message ID used in path parameters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for forward pagination. Returns messages with message-id > cursor. Pass the value from the 'next' link header.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Field to sort by. Prefix with minus (-) for descending order.

**Examples:**
- `sort=sent_at` - Ascending by send time (oldest first)
- `sort=-sent_at` - Descending by send time (newest first)
- `sort=-updated_at` - Most recently updated first

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of additional fields/field groups to include.

**Field groups:**
- `metadata` - Includes message_properties, party_info, and collaboration_info
- `attachments` - Includes payload_info array
- `errors` - Includes error logs

**Individual fields:**
- `message_properties`
- `party_info`
- `collaboration_info`
- `payload_info`

**Examples:**
- `fields=metadata,errors` - Groups only
- `fields=message_properties,errors` - Mix of individual field and group
- `fields=errors` with `Prefer: return=minimal` header - Returns id+status+timestamp+errors only

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: RFC 7240 Prefer header. 'return=minimal' (id, message_id, role, status, sent_at only), 'return=representation' (full metadata, default).

200.description: Array of messages. Response format depends on 'Prefer' header: 'return=representation' returns full MessageDetails objects, 'return=minimal' returns lightweight MessageSummary objects. Pagination links provided in Link header (RFC 5988).

Link.description: RFC 5988 compliant web links for pagination. Contains comma-separated links with rel values: 'self' (current page), 'first' (first page), 'prev' (previous page, if not first), 'next' (next page, if not last), 'last' (last page). Example: <https://api.example.org/api/rest-plugin/v1/messages?cursor=abc123>; rel="self", <https://api.example.org/api/rest-plugin/v1/messages?cursor=xyz789>; rel="next"

Preference-Applied.description: RFC 7240 header indicating which representation preference was applied (return=representation or return=minimal).

example1.summary: Single message filtered by message_id (full representation)
example1.description: Query: ?message_id=urn:uuid:abc123-def4-5678-90ab-cdef12345678@sender.eu with default Prefer: return=representation. Returns complete metadata including party_info, collaboration_info, and attachment details.

example2.summary: Multiple messages with minimal representation (Prefer: return=minimal)
example2.description: Query without message_id filter, using Prefer: return=minimal header. Returns array of messages with only essential fields (id, message_id, msh_role, processing_type, status, auto_send). Efficient for listing/searching.

example3.description: Query: ?message_id=urn:uuid:... with default Prefer: return=representation. Demonstrates message with multiple attachments (2 attachments), showing complete metadata for each attachment including content_id, content_type, content_status.

example4.summary: GET messages with errors using fields parameter
example4.description: Sample response using `fields=errors` to include error logs for messages in SEND_FAILURE status. Uses `Prefer: return=minimal` header to return only essential fields (id, metadata.message_info.message_id, processing_info.msh_role, processing_info.processing_type, processing_info.status, processing_info.errors).

filter.description: RSQL/FIQL filter expression to select messages for resend. Supports operators: `==`, `!=`, `=lt=`, `=le=`, `=gt=`, `=ge=`, `=in=`, `=out=`, `AND`, `OR`, `()`. Filterable fields: `status`, `mshRole`, `processingType`, `fromParty`, `toParty`, `messageId`, `conversationId`, `receivedFrom`, `receivedTo`. Examples: `status==SEND_FAILURE`, `status==SEND_FAILURE AND fromParty==DOMIBUS_RED`, `status=in=(SEND_FAILURE,SEND_ATTEMPT_FAILED) AND processingType==PUSH`, `(status==SEND_FAILURE OR status==SEND_ATTEMPT_FAILED) AND receivedFrom=ge=2025-01-01T00:00:00Z`.

content_ref.description:
Reference to the location of the attachment content. This field is used when the content is NOT embedded in the 'content' field (e.g., for later upload or large files). Supported reference types include:
  • File URI: `file:///path/to/local/file` (internal file system reference).
  • Web Resource: `https://external.domain.com/resource` (external HTTP/HTTPS URL).
If this field is present, the system will attempt to resolve the content from this location.

content.description: Base64 encoded content of the attachment. Included only in full representations or for small files.

content_status_detail.description: Additional details about the content status. Provides context for DOWNLOADING (progress), DOWNLOAD_FAILED (error message), UPLOADING (progress), or other states. Null when status is AVAILABLE or no additional details needed.

MessageStatus.description:
Represents the current processing state of an AS4 message within the Domibus MSH system.

State transitions during message creation:
  • Incomplete attachments (uploads required): Message enters CREATED state with substatus PENDING_UPLOADS. Awaits manual upload via PUT /messages/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId}. After all uploads complete, transitions to READY_TO_SEND (if auto_send_if_complete=true) or remains CREATED with substatus PENDING_USER_ACTION (if auto_send_if_complete=false). If external references also need resolution, transitions to substatus PENDING_REFERENCE_RESOLUTION first.
  • URL-referenced attachments (external resolution required): Message enters CREATED state with substatus PENDING_REFERENCE_RESOLUTION. Server resolves file:// or https:// references asynchronously. After resolution completes, transitions to READY_TO_SEND (if auto_send_if_complete=true) or remains CREATED with substatus PENDING_USER_ACTION (if auto_send_if_complete=false).
  • Mixed attachments (both uploads and references): Message enters CREATED with substatus PENDING_UPLOADS (higher priority). After uploads complete, transitions to substatus PENDING_REFERENCE_RESOLUTION while server resolves external references. After all attachments ready, transitions to READY_TO_SEND (if auto_send_if_complete=true) or remains CREATED with substatus PENDING_USER_ACTION (if auto_send_if_complete=false).
  • Complete attachments + auto_send_if_complete=true: Message transitions immediately to READY_TO_SEND, then automatically to SEND_ENQUEUED.
  • Complete attachments + auto_send_if_complete=false: Message remains in CREATED state with substatus PENDING_USER_ACTION until explicit POST /messages/{id}/send-request call triggers transition to READY_TO_SEND → SEND_ENQUEUED.
